name: bannor_warrior
description: a Bannor Warrior, a young human clubman: tousled brown hair under a red headband knotted at the back of the head, a stubbled jaw, bare tan muscular arms, a white sleeveless tunic with red trim and a red strap across the chest, a red belt with a round gold buckle, a red kilt with a white front panel, white cloth wraps below the knees, brown leather boots, a wooden club studded with round brass studs in his RIGHT hand and a round red shield with a steel rim and a gold sun emblem on his LEFT arm
hands: the club stays in his right hand on the screen-left side and the shield on his left arm on the screen-right side

strike.1: anticipation: weight shifts back onto the rear leg, torso leans back toward the upper-left, the studded club is lifted beside the head with its heavy end pointing up and back
strike.2: wind-up extreme: body coiled back and crouched, the club hand behind the head and the studded club hanging down behind the shoulders to the left, the sun shield tucked across the belly
strike.3: swing: the front foot steps toward the lower-right, the torso whips round, the club arm sweeps across in front of the chest and the studded club is level, its heavy end pointing to the right
strike.4: contact: club arm fully extended toward the lower-right, the studded club smashing down-right, front knee bent, body low and leaning in, the sun shield swung back behind the shoulders for balance
strike.5: follow-through: the club carries on down until its studded end nearly touches the ground at the lower-right, torso twisted, hair and headband ends trailing back
strike.6: recover: body rises, front foot pulls back halfway, the studded club comes back up on the near side toward the ready angle, the sun shield tucked across the belly

flinch.0: impact: hit from the lower-right; head snaps back toward the upper-left, eyes squeezed shut, torso jolts back, both arms jerk outward (club arm thrown up and out to the left, the sun shield flung out to the right)
flinch.1: recoil extreme: leaning back further toward the upper-left, knees bent, the studded club dipping, the sun shield still held out

death.1: stagger back: a step back toward the upper-left, body thrown back, club arm flung up, the sun shield drooping
death.2: knees buckle: hips drop, knees fold forward, torso slumps forward, head droops, the studded club lowering
death.3: kneeling: on both knees, slumped forward, the club's studded end resting on the ground at the lower-right, shield arm hanging
death.4: falling back: torso tips back toward the upper-left, the studded club slips out of the hand, legs slide forward
death.5: hits the ground: lying on his back along the ground, feet toward the lower-right and head toward the upper-left; the studded club lies on the ground at the lower-right; the round sun shield lies flat beside him
death.7: corpse: lying flat and still on his back, eyes closed, the studded club and the sun shield on the ground beside him
